name: connector-trim
description: Makes big JSON results of MCP connectors cheaper: trims them by code and saves the full result, as returned, to a file. Redacts nothing; a helper model is called only if you turn use_helper on

min_chars.title: Trim results over (characters)
min_chars.description: A connector result shorter than this reaches Claude untouched (at least 1,000; a lower value counts as 1,000)

trim_target_chars.title: Ask the helper over (characters, after trimming)
trim_target_chars.description: With use_helper on, a trimmed result shorter than this reaches Claude as trimmed, with no model call (at least 500; a lower value counts as 500). Not used with use_helper off

condense_text.title: Condense text results too
condense_text.description: Off: only JSON results are shortened, and text (files, documents, logs) reaches Claude whole. On, together with use_helper: big text results are sent to the helper model as they are and condensed

use_helper.title: Use the helper model
use_helper.description: Off (default): the mod never calls a model. On: a result still over trim_target_chars after trimming is sent to the helper model, as the tool returned it apart from the trim and with nothing redacted, together with your last request and the call's arguments

time_budget_ms.title: Time budget (ms)
time_budget_ms.description: The most time code may spend on one result before it passes the result whole, as the tool returned it (0 passes every result whole)

skip.title: Never trim
skip.description: Servers or tools (short or full name, * as a wildcard) whose results always reach Claude whole. A bare tool name matches that tool on every server

only.title: Only trim
only.description: When set, only these servers or tools are trimmed (the never-trim list still wins)

keep_days.title: Keep saved results (days)
keep_days.description: Saved full results older than this are cleared (at least 1; a lower value counts as 1)

max_saved_mb.title: Saved results cap (MB)
max_saved_mb.description: The oldest saved results are cleared once the folder holds more than this (at least 10; a lower value counts as 10)

helper_model.title: Helper model
helper_model.description: The model that condenses a result still big after trimming, with use_helper on
